notes.title: Quick Announcement/Update about the eBook DLC...
notes.notes:
So the first big piece of news: yes, I'm working on it.  For the first draft, I'm just porting all the lines over into a Word document and then reformatting them into something more bookish.  From there, its just going to be revising and making it read like PROPER LITERATURE.  Okay, maybe not "proper" on the lines of Sherlock Holmes or something.  But more proper than it currently is.

But as I'm going through, I'm noticing a lot of lines that aren't as clear as when I first wrote the visual novel.  Which is a normal process, I've learned.  What reads great before doesn't read so well when you check on it months or years later.  But the great thing about visual novels is that you can update them much easier than you can a published book.  So while I am working on the novelization, I'm also revising the game.

So eventually, this game is going to get not only an eBook for DLC but it will get what I assume will be a fairly big update.  Basically revising scenes from good to better.  I'll come up with a kicky name for this update later.

No idea when either will release just yet, so stay tuned.  :-)

(Also if you haven't checked out the sequel's demo yet, its still up and its still in Next Fest.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2323650/Clash_Blue_Mirage/

So there you go, there's that.)

notes.title: A quick update...
notes.notes: All that I did was update a background that had some name brands in it that someone helpfully pointed out, so now there should be no risk of me getting in trouble.  :-)

notes.title: Version 2.1 Available Today!
notes.notes:
I learned something after two years of writing visual novels: how to install a spell-checker on my chosen coding program.  Because of that, version 2.1 of [i]Clash: Robot Detective - Complete Edition[/i] is now available!

[list]
[*]Persuasive achievement should now unlock
[*]A whole slew of spelling errors have been corrected
[*]Like, an embarrassing about of spelling errors have been corrected
[*]Behind-the-scenes trivia updated to be a bit more accurate to current events (since I was digging around in that script anyway)
[/list]

Thank you all for your support and patience!

(Also, [i]Clash: Blue Mirage[/i] demo coming in February.  Probably.  Most likely.)

notes.title: Hype Update #4: General New Years Well-Wishing
notes.notes:
A quick update to wish you a very happy New Year's!  May your 2023 be interesting but also safe.

This quick update is also a reminder that [i]Clash: Robot Detective - Complete Edition[/i] releases on Steam on [b]January 2nd, 2023[/b]!  Oh goodness, that is just around the corner!  I hope you're all as excited as I am about this big step in Clash's journey.

Speaking of Clash's journey, [i]Clash: Blue Mirage[/i] (the sequel) is currently in development.  A demo will be making its way on Steam in a month or so and the rest of the game will arrive when its ready.  Also making a space adventure that has nothing to do with Clash, but don't worry too much about that.

...that's all I got today.  There will be an announcement when the game releases (as well as Steam's automatic notifications if you have the game wishlisted so if you haven't wishlisted yet then please do so!), with another announcement on the 14th to wrap it all up with a nice post-mortem.  But right now, all I have left to say is see you Monday for the release.  :-)

notes.title: Clash's Steam Release Date Pushed Up!
notes.notes:
In planning when to release Clash on Steam, I wanted to avoid any big or hyped-up dates.  And believe me, my research showed that there was a LOT of them.  1/6 was originally picked because there was nothing.

Then Splatfest weekend was announced, and guess.  which.  weekend.  it.  was.

When the dev herself is planning on skimping on release maintenance to go play another game, she knows she's gotta change it.

Gave it some thought and decided on a weekday launch instead of a weekend.  Mostly because the weekday in question is my last day off before I have to go back to my day job.  So thats a good amount of time to stoke the hype fires.

So Clash's new Steam release date is [b][i]January 2nd, 2023![/i][/b]

Only issue there is that it is the same release date as Jellyfish Parade's [i]Belle Automata[/i], which is also a robot visual novel.  One that I'm excited for, so I'd love to share a release date with it.  So when you guys buy my game, you should totally buy that one too.  Make it a VN double-feature.  

(Third hype update still coming on Christmas Eve.  And a fourth update New Year's Eve, just because.)
